How this price is worked out  Pacific Fair hoardings are charged per lineal metre (lm) under the agreed BSG Commercial Internal Hoarding Schedule of Rates for GPT - Pacific Fair 25-26.  The lineal metres are the full hoarding run, which includes the returns and sides as well as the front: 1,600 + 11,000 + 1,600 = 14,200 mm = 14.2 lm.  The hoarding is 4,500 mm high, so it falls in the up to 4.8 m high band at $330.00 per lm (ex GST). The rate rises with height because taller hoardings need more melamine, more counterweights per upright and more labour to install safely.  The run is above the 10 lm minimum charge, so the actual length is charged.  14.2 lm x $330.00 = $4,686.00 ex GST, plus GST at 10%. 4. What is included  Supply, delivery, installation and removal of the TITAN free-standing hoarding system.  Structural engineering certification to AS4687 (pre-engineered certified hoarding).  16 mm white melamine boards with white taped joints and black skirting tape along the bottom.  One set of double doors, opening 2340 mm high x 1600 mm wide, with barrel bolt (deadbolt lock provided by Pacific Fair).  Free-standing installation: nothing is fixed to the centre's finishes, so there is no damage and no make-good work when the hoarding is removed.  Hoarding drawing for approval (attached).  Hoarding on site for up to 6 months before further charges apply.

Hoarding limit on photo · 2. Plan and elevation · 3. Melamine layout · 4. Suggested Build Sequence · 5. Site checks · 6. Materials form 1. Hoarding limit on the photo The red outline is the hoarding limit on the floor; the crossed box is the entry. The entry starts 4.8 m from the left end of the front.
2. Plan and elevation All sizes in mm. The dashed red line is the lease line (the shopfront): nothing is fixed to it.

3. Melamine layout and cutting plan Each panel is numbered by the sheet it is cut from. Full sheets S1 to S9 go in whole; the cut pieces sit at the corners. S10 gives the 1000 strip for the front right. S11 gives the 400 strip for the left return and the 400 strip for the right return. S12 is turned sideways and cut to one 1600 x 1200 piece above the entry. Note: instead of cutting S12, the door-top pieces can be cut in the factory from a spare sheet and sent to the job. Each top is the same width as the sheet below it, so every join is one straight line from floor to top. Tops T1 to T9 go in whole. T10 is cut 1000. T11 is cut 400 + 400. Above the entry goes one 1600 x 900 piece cut from S12.

4. Suggested Build Sequence Build left to right as seen from the mall: left return, front, right return. 1 Check the truck. Before leaving, check the truck against the materials form to make sure all the material was loaded, including the 2 spare sheets. 2 Arrive and secure the area. Sign in with centre management. Set up barrier tape and the bollard around the work zone. Lay the dust suppression. 3 Set out the hoarding limit. Mark both ends of the lease line and measure 1600 out from each. Snap the 11000 front line parallel to the shopfront. 4 Mark the entry. Measure 4800 from the left end of the front line and mark a 1600 opening (4800 to 6400). 5 Stand the Titan uprights. 14 uprights, each one at a joint between two sheets (never in the middle of a sheet), including one each side of the entry, 7 counterweights on each (weight matrix for 4.5 m; 108 sent, incl. 10% spare). They are marked on the melamine layout. 6 Frame the walls. Fix the 70 x 45 MGP 10 studs (4.5 m) so every melamine joint lands on a stud. Frame the entry with 2 x 4.5 m and 4 x 2.3 m door studs and a head at 2400. 7 Fix the 3600 sheets. Left return S1, S11a (400, at the corner); front left S2, S3, S4, S5; front right S6, S7, S8, S10 (1000, at the corner); right return S9, S11b (400, at the corner). 8 Fill above the entry. One 1600 x 1200 piece (S12) between the door head at 2400 and 3600. 9 Fix the tops. 900 tops from 3600 to 4500 along the whole run. Each top is the same width as the sheet below it, so every join is one straight line from floor to top. Tops T1 to T9 go in whole. T10 is cut 1000. T11 is cut 400 + 400. Above the entry goes one 1600 x 900 piece cut from S12. 10 Hang the doors. Two 2340 leaves on 4 hinges, metal plates and deadbolt. Check they close and lock. 11 Finish. White tape on every vertical joint, black skirting tape along the base, screw covers, anti-tampers, 6 warning stickers, paint touch-ups. 12 Hand over. Clean up, remove the barrier, photograph each side, complete the installation certificate and sign INST CHK. 5. Site checks Confirm before fixing anything; update the drawings if any differ. [ ] The front measures 11000. [ ] The ceiling is above 4500 along the whole run. [ ] The entry starts 4800 from the left end of the front. [ ] The 1600 returns leave the walkway centre management requires. [ ] Nothing is fixed to the shopfront or floor; the Titan counterweights hold the hoarding. 6.
